title: No Final Night: Protect The Sponk Can
description:
THE LAST SPONK ENERGY CAN IN THE WORLDYou are the night guard at your local copper factory. Boring job, dead end town, nothing ever happens... except your factory is sitting on the LAST Sponk Energy can left on Earth.

And three Sponk addicted junkies want it BAD.

SURVIVE FROM 12 AM TO 6 AMEvery night, Motan, Grigore and Foca will do whatever it takes to break into your office, get their hands on that can, and leave you with nothing. You get a tiny office, two doors, some lights, a wall of security cameras, and a battery that is absolutely NOT your friend, that btw its an UPS from nJOY xD. Everything you do drains power, and when the power dies... you are not alone for long.

• Watch the cameras - track the junkies room by room. The cameras won't tell you who's where. You have to look, and you have to listen.

• Slam the doors - a closed door keeps them out, but it eats your power fast.

• Flick the lights - peek into the doorways to catch someone standing right next to you.

• Manage your power - you start every night at 100%. Doors, lights and cameras all drain it. Hit 0% and it's over.

Every one of them hunts differently. Grigore comes down the left. Foca comes down the right. And Motan? Motan does NOT wait his turn , take your eyes off him for too long and he sprints straight for your door, because he is a sneaky bastard hunter and your worst nightmare that ever existed.

THERE IS NO FINAL NIGHTEvery night is 5% harder than the last. The junkies get faster, thirstier and smarter, and the game never stops throwing nights at you. No ending. No victory screen. No "you won." There is only the next night.

So how long can you last? :3

FEATURING• Endless, escalating survival horror - every night is harder than the last

• Three relentless enemies, each with their own way of hunting you down

• Loud jumpscares and intense strobe and flashing effects (you have been warned!!!)

• Full controller support, built and optimized for Steam Deck (some additional button mapping required, see in game controls for more informations i.e r4, l4, r5, l5)

• An unhealthy amount of Sponk Energy drinks
description_short: You are the night guard protecting the last Sponk Energy can in the world, and three energy drink junkies will break into your office to steal it. Watch the cameras, slam the doors and burn your power wisely to survive from 12 AM to 6 AM. Every night is harder than the last. There is no final night.
